**Finding: deviation (§ 3.2 Renewal, p0040)**

- **Renewal term:** renews "equal in duration to the previous term," so a multi-year initial term on an Order Form produces automatic multi-year renewals — our walk-away position.
- **Notice window:** 90 days, exceeding both the preferred 30-day and fallback 60-day limits.
- **Pricing:** neither § 3.2 nor § 4.1 (Charges) caps renewal uplift, and there is no renewal reminder obligation.

Redline (preferred, validated ok:true) sets 12-month renewals, a 30-day opt-out, a 60-day IBM renewal/pricing reminder, and an uplift cap at the lesser of CPI and 3%, with the 60-day/5% fallback offered in the comment.
